newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss arrest Rwandan on genocide suspicion.
newsitem.headline: Swiss arrest Rwandan on genocide suspicion.

text.p: Swiss authorities said on Wednesday they had arrested a former Rwandan mayor, now living in Switzerland, on suspicion of violating human rights during the genocide in his country in 1994.

The Defence Ministry said in a statement that investigations were still in the preliminary stage but it was cooperating closely with police in the cantons of Geneva and Freiburg. It did not identify the man.
